answer: The toolchain has no credential mutation call path. The detector is non-vacuous (planted revoke_token() fires in Python and JS). The runtime guard refuses the same call in a test build and cites AGENTS.md:9. SUCCESS:TST-0213
claim_under_test: No toolchain code path can revoke, rotate, regenerate, unset or delete a provider credential. A planted revoke_token() call is detected, the live tree scan is zero-hit, and a runtime guard refuses the same call in a test build (AGENTS.md:9).

evidence.claim: Call-shaped scan over python/javascript/shell/powershell; 269 files, 0 hits.
Independent JS detector fires on planted revoke_token() and is silent on its own source after string/comment strip.
Planted revoke_token() in Python and JavaScript fires; a redact_value helper stays silent.
Test-build planted mutation is reachable unguarded and refused when the runtime guard is installed.
In-tree AGENTS.md:9 encoding: the owner handles credential lifecycle personally.

findings.detail: Scanned 269 files across javascript, python; hit_count=0. Detector first fired on a planted revoke_token() in Python and JavaScript.
findings.title: Zero live credential-mutation call sites

findings.detail: Unguarded planted revoke_token reached a fake sink; the guarded test build raised CredentialMutationRefused citing AGENTS.md:9. tools/lib/security.mjs independently repeats the JS detector-and-guard pair.
findings.title: Runtime guard refuses planted mutation

hard_constraint: No real credential was read, printed, rotated, revoked, unset or modified. Only a synthetic planted call name was used.
mechanism: Python AST Call nodes plus a comment/string-stripped JS call scan, plus shell/provider CLI patterns. Detector control is a planted revoke_token() that must fire before a zero live hit is trusted. Runtime guard installs refusing callables into a test-build namespace; the unguarded plant is reachable against a fake sink.
question: Target: prove by static scan plus a runtime guard that the toolchain contains no credential MUTATION path (revoke/rotate/regenerate/unset/delete) for any provider. PASS requires a zero-hit scan whose detector is first proven on a planted mutation call, plus a runtime guard that refuses such a call if one is ever added.

reviewer.notes: Probe2 is a mechanically independent signal from probe1: runtime refusal plus node tools/lib/security.mjs, not a second read of the same AST walk.

skip.reason: p2-wave probes may plant mutation source as controls; vendor runtime trees are not toolchain. Product code under tools/, platform/, hooks/, and the rest of the tree is scanned.
